column1: # libm.so.6 compat (non-default) versions versions.tsv lists that Liella does not export yet (binary-compatibility phase 15).
# RATCHET (rulings #1176, #1187): this list may only shrink. `cargo xtask so` fails (naming the symbol) on
#   - a compat version versions.tsv lists that libm.so.6 does not export and that is NOT listed here;
#   - a listed entry that libm.so.6 now exports ("remove it from compat-missing-libm.tsv"): delete the row in the same commit;
#   - a listed entry that is not a compat (non-default) row of versions.tsv (defaults can never be listed).
# Never add rows to make the check pass: build the missing compat version instead (SO-CHECK-DEFAULT-VERSION).
